# dc-uar: ENCODEURL: each printable ASCII character between two letters, non-ASCII text (UTF-8 bytes),
# numbers, logicals, an error, a reference and the 32,767-character limit of the result.
# Each call is written with its _xlfn. prefix, as Excel writes a function newer than Excel 2007.
